# Sus Party

> Sus Party (susparty.com) is a free real-life party game inspired by Among Us and Mafia. It is a website, not an app: everyone opens susparty.com in a phone browser and joins with a room code, with nothing to download. Players get secret roles, walk around a real place doing real tasks, call meetings and vote out the intruders. It works for 3 to 20+ players at parties, sleepovers, youth groups and classrooms. A laptop can optionally show the room code and task progress. Sus Party is independent and not affiliated with Innersloth or Among Us.

Sus Party is not the "SusParty" mobile app from app stores; that is a different product by a different developer.

## Play

- [Host or join a game](https://susparty.com/play): create a room and share the code
- [How to play Sus Party](https://susparty.com/how-to-play): hosting, tasks, sabotage cards, meetings and votes
- [FAQ](https://susparty.com/faq): player counts, setup, phones, and the optional laptop screen

## Among Us in real life

- [Among Us IRL](https://susparty.com/among-us-irl): play Among Us in real life on your phones
- [How to play Among Us in real life](https://susparty.com/how-to-play-among-us-irl): rules and setup
- [Among Us task ideas](https://susparty.com/among-us-irl-task-ideas): real-life tasks for home, school and parties
- [Task generator](https://susparty.com/among-us-irl-task-generator): build a room-by-room task list
- [Role generator](https://susparty.com/among-us-role-generator): deal secret roles on one shared phone
- [Printable task cards](https://susparty.com/among-us-task-cards-printable)
